cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
cards.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: File the bakery's contract rejection under training, please. This is exactly how we learn not to depend on one customer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We needed that contract to pay the mixer loan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the lesson arrived just in time. Write down how many loaves we can make by hand. No, not how many we wish we could make.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Forty. That won't cover the payments either.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then halve the batch on tomorrow's plan. We needed to learn the difference between growing and staying open. Please sharpen the pencil; this part matters.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1/A3 teach rejection as needed growth, but A5's next instruction does not coherently serve even A's stated survival lesson.

relationship.evidence: B4 contributes a concrete production and payment limit.

heightening.evidence: A5's halving is an arbitrary worsening rather than an earned development of B4's constraint.
